_comment: Plain words that mean the same, for the front door's search (docs/design/front-door.md, section 4.3). People arrive with a symptom in their own words and spelling; the guides are written in one spelling. Each row is a set of words any one of which matches the others. A row must hold only words that mean the same thing: "runs" was in the diarrhoea row for an hour and sent "diarrhea" to the furnace filter first ("so it runs as it should"). Found 2026-11-02: an American typing "diarrhea" found nothing, because the ORS how-to says "diarrhoea". The real build would move this file to data/front_door/search_words.json and the How-to page would read it too.
_ignore: Small words a person types that no guide's search words need: they are dropped from the query, so "my jar lid is bulging" asks for jar, lid and bulging. English only: a translation brings its own list.
